'''Crosslink beam emitter''' were portable communications [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]]. They were used by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces in conjunction with [[transponder dish]]es during a deployment on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] to scan local [[Subspace transceiver/Legends|subspace]] and [[Hypercomm/Legends|hypercomm]] frequencies.
